Welcome to GDH

Your product, on the shelves that matter.

GDH buys your product, stocks it and sells it into the country’s largest store chains and dental practices. One partner for the whole route to market — and it costs your brand nothing.

Partner with usWhat we do

What do you need?

First-time distribution

You make it. We get it on shelf.

Most brands we carry arrive after years of pitching chain buyers on their own. We already supply those buyers every week, so your range enters a conversation that is already happening.

Read more

The dental channel

Dentistry does not buy like retail.

Small, frequent, clinically specific orders, decided by the practitioner. We are in those practices every week, which is a far shorter road than building a dental sales force from scratch.

Read more

Sectors

Two channels, one network.

Retail and dental share our warehouses and our delivery routes. Each has its own commercial team, because the two buy nothing alike.

Grocery

Health & Beauty

Convenience

Dental

Materials and consumables into practices and laboratories.
